sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding pump housing ph-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We highly value our long-standing cooperation and are committed to securing your full requirements.
We are willing to accept the 24-month contract term and the April 2027 start date as you proposed.
For the 30-day payment package, we can offer a revised price of €51.80, reflecting a genuine step toward an agreement.
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate your continued movement and your commitment to our partnership, which has linked our houses for so many years. In the spirit of this long relationship, we are taking another significant step towards you by reducing our price to €50.60 for the 30-day payment package. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €50.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

We are confident that we are closing the gap and will soon reach a fair agreement that honors both our shared history and the craftsmanship of our foundry team.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
